name: Pazuzu
tactics: Pazuzu in Combat Pazuzu rarely engages in direct combat, though his abilities make the demon lord a formidable opponent. The plague of abyssal locusts that surrounds him keeps melee and ranged attackers at bay while he spreads his pestilence across the battlefield. The demon lord delights in dominating his most powerful foes, forcing them to cut down their own allies in his name. Pazuzu out of Combat If a creature utters Pazuzu’s name or any of his aliases three times in succession, an unholy link between the speaker and the demon lord is established, working over any distance and across the planes. For a short time, Pazuzu can examine the speaker’s thoughts to discern whether the caller seeks aid or is trying to trap him. If he wants to and is able to, Pazuzu can appear in the speaker’s location. The demon lord almost always agrees to provide aid, but his assistance comes at a steep price. In game terms, a typical call for aid from Pazuzu can take the form of gaining a free action point, restoring a character to life or to full hit points, recharging an expended power, or some other benefit of the DM’s choosing. In exchange for this boon, Pazuzu requires a creature to swear utter obedience for a week or more—and takes full advantage of this service.

alignment.name: Chaotic Evil
alignment.description:
Chaotic evil creatures have a complete disregard for others. They kill, steal, and betray others to gain power. Their word is meaningless and their actions destructive. Their worldviews can be so warped that they destroy anything and anyone that doesn’t directly contribute to their interests.
	By the standards of good and lawful good people, chaotic evil is as abhorrent as evil, perhaps even more so. Chaotic evil monsters such as demons and orcs are at least as much of a threat to civilization and general well-being as evil monsters are. An evil creature and a chaotic evil creature are both opposed to good, but they don’t have much respect for each other either and rarely cooperate toward common goals.
	For the purpose of game effects, a chaotic evil creature is also considered evil.

description: Creatures larger than Medium take up more than 1 square. For instance, an ogre takes up a space that is 2 squares by 2 squares. Most Large and larger creatures also have a reach greater than 1, which means they can make melee attacks against creatures that aren’t adjacent to them. A creature’s basic body shape usually determines its reach; a Large ogre has a reach of 2, but a Large horse has a reach of 1.

traits.name: Plague of Abyssal Locusts
traits.details: Any enemy that ends its turn within the aura takes 15 damage. Creatures within the aura have concealment against ranged attacks. While Pazuzu is bloodied, the aura’s size increases to 10, and enemies within the aura also cannot shift.

traits.name: Master of Manipulation
traits.details: At the start of each of his turns, Pazuzu can choose either to slide one creature he can see 3 squares, or to make a saving throw against an effect that includes the dazed or stunned condition.

auras.name: Plague of Abyssal Locusts
auras.details: Any enemy that ends its turn within the aura takes 15 damage. Creatures within the aura have concealment against ranged attacks. While Pazuzu is bloodied, the aura’s size increases to 10, and enemies within the aura also cannot shift.

effect.description: Pazuzu shifts 15 squares and makes the following attack against each creature he moves adjacent to during the shift.

hit.description: The target takes ongoing 20 poison damage and is weakened (save ends both). This ongoing damage is not reduced by poison resistance.

effect.description: Pazuzu can alter his physical form to appear as any Large or smaller creature, including a unique individual, until he attacks, until he uses change shape again, or until he drops to 0 hit points. Pazuzu retains his statistics in his new form. His clothing, armor, and other possessions do not change. To assume a specific individual’s for, Pazuzu must have seen that individual. Other creatures can make a DC 31 Insight check to discern that the form is a disguise.

hit.description: Pazuzu slides the target 1 square, then the target uses an at-will attack power of Pazuzu’s choice against the triggering enemy as a free action. If this attack hits, the triggering attack also takes a -4 penalty to the attack roll.

powers.name: Variable Resistance
powers.trigger: Pazuzu takes acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage.

effect.description: Pazuzu gains resist 30 to the triggering damage type until the end of the encounter or until he uses variable resistance again.
